title: Charter Contract
description: Contract for charter-contract.json (#3481): what a valid CHARTER.md is — its title, required sections, Key Entities table, the unfilled-placeholder rule and the shape thresholds — with verdict cases any implementation of the placeholder rule must reproduce. Read by .claude/scripts/shared/lib/charter-template.js, lib/charter-shape.js and charter-entities.js.

flags.description: ECMAScript flags. Never 'g': a global regex keeps lastIndex between test() calls.

pattern.description: Regular expression line 1 of CHARTER.md must match.

form.description: The title as written in the /charter spec, {name} standing for the project name.

role.description: The title's role (#3515): a generation requirement only — what /charter writes and line 1 must match — never an input to the filled/unfilled decision, which the placeholder rule alone makes.

description.description: The stated role, in prose, for a downstream consumer.

requiredSections.description: Section headings a charter must carry, in target order.

heading.description: Heading text of the Key Entities section, without the leading hashes.

tableHeader.description: Column names of the Key Entities table, in order (#2379).

pattern.description: Regular expression source matching one unfilled placeholder. ANY match outside code makes the charter a template.

codeExclusion.description: Text removed before matching: braces inside code are literal content, never placeholders. Code stripping is an algorithm, not a regex; cases[] is what binds two implementations of it.

inlineCode.description: What an inline code span is.

inScopeBulletWords.description: An In Scope bullet longer than this many words is a shape finding.

cases.description: Conformance suite: charter fragments with the verdict every implementation of the placeholder rule must return.
